import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] num11 = new long[20];
    static long[] pow10 = new long[20];
    static int ans = -1;

    static void pre() {
        pow10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++) {
            pow10[i] = pow10[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        num11[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++) {
            num11[i] = num11[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
    }

    static int get_len(long x) {
        int res = 0;
        while (x != 0) {
            res++;
            x /= 10;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void dfs(int pos, long x, int cnt) {
        if (ans != -1 && cnt >= ans)
            return;
        if (x == 0 || pos == 0) {
            if (ans != -1)
                ans = Math.min(ans, cnt);
            else
                ans = cnt;
            return;
        }
        if (x < 0)
            x = -x;
        long t_x = x;
        int t_cnt = 0;
        while (t_x >= pow10[pos - 1]) {
            t_x -= num11[pos];
            t_cnt += pos;
        }
        dfs(pos - 1, t_x, cnt + t_cnt);
        t_x = num11[pos + 1] - x;
        t_cnt = 0;
        while (t_x >= pow10[pos - 1]) {
            t_x -= num11[pos];
            t_cnt += pos;
        }
        dfs(pos - 1, t_x, cnt + pos + 1 + t_cnt);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        pre();
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        ans = -1;
        dfs(get_len(x), x, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
